descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]……终于，我们回来了。

我们的民族曾经历了难以想象的苦难。从家园中被掳走，被迫拷上脚镣，或是成为任人买卖的契约财产，往往我们要面对的就是这些凶残的遭遇。即便是那些过得稍微轻松一些的人身上也带着曾被奴役的耻辱。而现在，回到我们同胞的怀抱中，我们终于可以开始治愈创伤了。

但在欢乐之余我们别忘了，事实上我们是来自许多不同星球的民族。不论起源，我们中的每个人都有归乡的权利。

我们的前主人不择手段地打散我们。而今天，整个星系将见证他们的失败。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName]... At last, we have returned.

As a people, we have experienced unimaginable trauma. Stolen from our homes, forced into bondage, the life of an indentured asset was often one of brutal suffering. Even for those who passed their days in relative comfort, the shame of indenture lingers. Now, reunited with our kin, we can finally begin to heal.

But in our joy we must never lose sight of the fact that we are a people of many worlds. No matter our origins, every one of us deserves the chance to return home.

Our former masters did their best to break us. Today the whole galaxy is witness to their failure.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]……肯定是搞错了什么。在轨道上我们无法探测到任何感性生命。所有的人口可能都被某种方式抹去了。

尽管这与我们预想的归乡大相径庭，但返回这个恒星系还是让我们向着寻回自己过去迈出了一步。不幸的是，我们得独自携带者[From.GetName]前行了，只有靠我们才能传承记忆。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName]... Something is very wrong here. From orbit, we can detect no signs of sentient life. Somehow, the entire population has been eliminated.

While this was not the homecoming we hoped for, by returning to this system we have taken another step towards reclaiming our past. Unfortunately, we alone must carry the legacy of [From.GetName]. It is up to us to remember.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]……这里发生了非常不好的事情。

被炸毁的土地上尘土飞荡。大部分的表面都被辐射了，少数绝望的幸存者在废墟中坚持生活。

虽然这不是我们所希望的归宿，但通过返回这个星系，我们已经向收回我们的过去的一步迈进了。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName]... Something very wrong has happened here.

Dust drifts across a blasted landscape. Much of the surface is irradiated, and the few desperate survivors cling to life in the ruins.

While this was not the homecoming we hoped for, by returning to this system we have taken another step towards reclaiming our past.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]……自从我们被掳走以来，这里发生了蓬勃的发展。他们不再被局限于单一行星上，而是已经迈向了繁星的征途。尽管这与我们预想的归乡大相径庭，但返[From.GetName]上的科技进步属实卓越。

而我们则已经没有了归处，我们被偷走的过去再也找不回来。我们现在能做的只有朝前看。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName]... Since we were taken from our home, much has transpired here. No longer bound to a single planet, the population has turned towards the stars. While this may not be the homecoming we expected, the technological progress on [From.GetName] is remarkable.

For us, there is no going back; our stolen past can never be reclaimed. All we can do now is look to the future.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]……自从我们被掳走以来，这里发生了很多事情。我们的这些同胞已经失去了主权，被另一个星系强权所统治了。

而我们则已经没有了归处，我们被偷走的过去再也找不回来。我们现在能做的只有朝前看。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName]... Since we were taken from our home, much has transpired here. Far from a sovereign people, our kin have been claimed by another galactic power.

For us, there is no going back; our stolen past can never be reclaimed. All we can do now is look to the future.

label.zh: 属于我们人民的伟大日子。
label.en: A great day for our people.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]……在轨道上看，它是这么地微小。

人们并不是拥有星球，而是属于这颗星球。回到这里，我们又向找回自己的过去迈进了一步。

我们在前主人的手中遭受的苦难永远不能弥消。真正的疗愈需要花费几个世代。但总之，今天确实是个好日子。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName]... From orbit, it appears so small.

A world does not belong to its people; it is the people who belong to their world. In returning here, we take another step towards reclaiming our past.

The trauma we experienced at the hands of our former masters can never be undone. True healing will take generations. But today is a good day.

descriptions.zh:
挣脱枷锁后，我们走出了成为一个民族的第一步。然而，在返回我们曾经的母星后，共同的目标开始发生动摇。

大众媒体充斥着对弥那玛特种实业集团到来前我们被母星上“返璞归真生活”的高度浪漫化的描述。而有许多人已经回到了母星。

如果我们不加以晶体，这可能会让我们的社会发生严重的动荡。
descriptions.en:
In casting off our shackles, we took the first step towards becoming a people. However, after returning to our former home world that sense of shared purpose has begun to wane.

Popular media is awash with highly romanticized depictions of the 'simple life' enjoyed on our former home world before the arrival of Minamar Specialized Industries. Many have already returned.

If we are not careful, this could have a seriously destabilizing effect on our society.

label.en: We cannot afford to lose any more of our people.

label.en: Freedom of movement is a fundamental right.

descriptions.zh: 一个新的群众运动已经在[Root.Capital.GetName]上站稳脚跟。这些极端分子自称为“归乡者”，主张我们应该将全体人民送回他们的起源行星，同时令国家解体。安全部队已将警戒状态提高到高级别，任何人数超过100人的公共集会都被禁止。
descriptions.en: A new movement has taken root on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Calling themselves The Returners, these extremists are advocating for the wholesale return of our people to their planets of origin, as well as the dissolution of our empire. Security forces have been placed on high alert, and all public gatherings of more than 100 individuals banned.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 归乡者们正在煽动反政府情绪，呼吁我们帝国的各物种落叶归根，回到自己的故土。该运动中最极端的派系已经和亲政府军队之间爆发了战斗。据报道，几个主要的城市中心已经遭到了严重的破坏。
descriptions.en: Stoking anti-government sentiment, The Returners are calling on the various species in our empire to return to their roots. Fighting has broken out between the movement's most extreme factions and pro-government forces. Severe damage has been reported in several major urban centers.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 虽然为了禁止人民返回他们各自的家园星球，我们付出了一定的代价，但事实最终证明了这个决策是正确的。近期，我们目睹社会凝聚力得到了明显的改善，同时，人们对于[Root.Capital.GetName]才是我们的家园这一观点有了崭新的共识。
descriptions.en: While forbidding our people to return to their respective home worlds has not been without its consequences, in the end it has proven the correct decision. Recently, we have witnessed a marked improvement in social cohesion, as well as a newfound sense that [Root.Capital.GetName] is indeed our home.

label.zh: 只有强人的手腕才能铸造国家。
label.en: Only a strong hand can forge a nation.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 虽然允许人们移民到我们曾经的家园星球在过去是一项群众喜闻乐见的政策，但也有相应的后果。最近，我们经历了一次重大的“人才流失”，因为一些最聪明的人才选择了迁往别处。
descriptions.en: While permitting emigration to our former home worlds has proven a popular policy, it has not been consequence-free. Recently, we have experienced a significant 'brain drain', as some of some of our brightest minds have made the choice to relocate.

label.zh: 我们必须避免人才进一步的流失。
label.en: We must prevent any further loss of talent.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 允许我们的人民返回自己的母星，作出这样的决策并非没有代价。但是，自由迁徙的政策推动了思想枷锁的解除。新的想法正在蓬勃发展，科学技术的进步已成为常态，而非一时的例外。
descriptions.en: The decision to allow our people to return to their home worlds was not without its costs, but with freedom of movement has come an unshackling in thought; new ideas are flourishing, and advances in science and technology are the norm rather than the exception.

descriptions.en: [From.GetName]... We had almost forgotten the scent of the air. To return now, after all we have experienced, feels almost unreal.

descriptions.zh:
在起义后，我们中有的人说，我们应该各奔前程了。他们坚称[Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]不是我们的家园，我们只不过是一群由契约资产组成的乌合之众，我们面临的困难太过艰巨不可战胜。

但我们第一座空间站的竣工，昭示着自由民能够完成伟大的壮举。只有想不到，没有做不到。
descriptions.en:
After the mutiny, there were some among us who said we should go our separate ways. They argued that [Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName] was not our home, that we were nothing but a motley band of indentured assets, and that the challenges before us were too great to overcome.

But with the building of our first Outpost, we've shown exactly what a free people can accomplish. The only limit is our own imagination.

descriptions.zh:
在摆脱桎梏的斗争历程中，我们迈出了成为一个民族的第一步。然而，近年来，大众媒体充斥着对我们以前在家园星球所享受的“朴素生活”的叙述，言语之间尽是浪漫美化。许多人已经吵着要回去。

如果我们不小心谨慎，这场运动将严重影响我们社会秩序的稳定。
descriptions.en:
In casting off our shackles, we took the first step towards becoming a people. However, in recent years, popular media is awash with highly romanticized depictions of the 'simple life' enjoyed on our former home world. Many are already clamoring to return.

If we are not careful, this movement could have a seriously destabilizing effect on our society.

descriptions.zh:
在起义中，将我们运往[Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]的运奴船受损严重。在紧急迫降后，我们的第一任务是生存，除了拆解舰船获取资源以外我们几乎没有什么别的想法。但现在是时候去发掘我们前主人的秘密了。

为此，首先我们要恢复舰船中央计算机的供能。我们的[engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj]工程师先是在船体的外部装配了一组太阳能电池，舰桥上的指挥控制台便可以恢复运转。但不幸的是，迫降时工程甲板的大门被卡死了，破拆防爆门进入其中可不是件容易的事。
descriptions.en:
During the mutiny, the slaver ship that carried us to [Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName] was badly damaged. After the crash, our first priority was survival, and other than stripping the ship for resources, we gave it little thought. But now the time has come to uncover the secrets of our former masters.

To do so, it will be necessary to restore power to the ship's central computer. As a first step, our [engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj] engineers rigged a series of solar cells to the ship's outer hull. The command consoles in the bridge are now operational. Unfortunately, the engineering deck was sealed off during the crash, and breaking through the blast doors won't be easy.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
弥那玛特种实业集团也不是盖的：这些蓄奴的混蛋还真挺能保护自己的机密。

敲开舰船的防爆门果然是一项史诗级任务。我们几乎没有设计用来进行小规模采矿作业的激光切割器。我们的团队只能是从甲板的下方挖洞才最终取得了进展。[engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj]工程师们现在已经开始加班加点恢复舰船其他部分的能量供应。
descriptions.en:
Say this much for Minamar Specialized Industries: the slave-holding scum know how to safeguard their secrets.

Prying open the ship's blast doors has proven a monumental task. What few laser cutters we possess were designed for low-scale mining operations. Only by tunneling up from the deck below was the team able to make any progress. [engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj] engineers are now hard at work restoring power to the rest of the ship's systems.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 虽然我们的[engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj]工程师已经设法恢复了飞船计算机核心的电源，但绝大部分的硬件还是在坠毁时损坏了。尽管还是有可能修复，但这样做意味着给我们已经负担过重的科学团队带来了更大的压力。
descriptions.en: While our [engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj] engineers have managed to restore power to the ship's computer core, a significant chunk of hardware was damaged in the crash. It should be possible to repair, but doing so means putting even more of a strain on our already overburdened science team.

label.zh: 我们需要那数据。修复核心。
label.en: We need that data. Repair the core.

label.zh: 我们需要那数据。修复核心。
label.en: We need that data. Repair the core.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
得益于一些异想天开的方案，我们的[engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj]工程师们诚通地重启了受损的计算机核心。在舰船系统中引入程序化人工智能，我们就可以开启会话。总的来说，我们感觉这台机器还是愿意帮我们一把的，而不是在碍我们事。

这项突破给予我们的科学家一些关于数据加密的新线索。随着我们逐渐在星系舞台上崭露头角，这些知识一定能派上用场的。
descriptions.en:
Thanks to some incredible, outside-the-box thinking, our [engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj] engineers have managed to restart the damaged computer core. By introducing a procedural AI to the ship's systems, we were able to engage it in dialogue. Essentially, we convinced the machine to work with, rather than against us.

The breakthrough has provided our scientists with new insights into the nature of data encryption. As we continue to make our presence felt on the galactic stage, such knowledge could prove invaluable.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 损坏的计算机核心已经完全修好了，尽管多数的数据是加密的，但破译工作已经开始。只要愿意花费时间和人力物力，我们迟早能获得包括我们原母星的位置在内的所有信息。
descriptions.en: The damaged computer core has been fully repaired, and while most of the data is encoded, decryption efforts are already underway. If we're willing to put in the time and allocate the resources, it's only a matter of time before we have access to everything - including the location of our former home worlds.

descriptions.zh:
损坏的计算机核心已经完全修好了，尽管多数的数据是加密的，但破译工作已经开始。只要愿意花费时间和人力物力，我们迟早能获得包括我们原母星的位置在内的所有信息。

事实上，我们或许已经收集到了一些对我们有利的信息：通过对在超空间航道网中穿梭的贩奴船进行三角定位，我们已经发现了弥那玛特种实业集团的宇宙坐标。

现在有两个选项摆在我们面前，直面前宗主，或是单纯祈祷上天降下惩罚。
descriptions.en:
The damaged computer core has been fully repaired, and while most of the data is encoded, decryption efforts are already underway. If we're willing to put in the time and allocate the resources, it's only a matter of time before we have access to everything - including the location of our former home worlds.

In fact, we may have already learned something to our advantage: by triangulating the hyperlane dilations along the slaver ship's flight path, we have uncovered the galactic coordinates of Minamar Specialized Industries.

We now have the choice, either to confront our former masters, or leave them to their fate.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 反编译坠毁殖民船数据库的特殊计划已经完成。我们找回了我们曾经的母星的位置。今日，我们大可庆祝我们在解放道路上踏出的又一步。
descriptions.en: The Special Project to decompile the databanks on the crashed slaver ship has concluded. We have uncovered the locations of our former home worlds. Today, we celebrate another step on the road to liberation.

label.zh: 属于我们人民的伟大日子。
label.en: A great day for our people.

tooltips.zh: 现在我们可以在情报日志中跟踪关于我们曾经的母星的发现。
tooltips.en: The discovery of our former home worlds can now be tracked in the Situation Log.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
团结一致反对我们以前的奴隶主很容易；有了一个共同的敌人，我们就能像拧成一股绳一样抗争和战斗。但随着自由的到来，人民内部的裂痕开始出现。

我们是来自不同星球的民族聚集体，我们的政治也同样多元。新的派系正在组建起来。肯定也会出现未来更多的派系。作为一个民族，我们能否妥善处理这些差异，将决定我们的命运。
descriptions.en:
To unite against our former masters was easy; with a common enemy, we struggled and fought as one. But with freedom, cracks have started to appear.

We are a people of many worlds, and our politics are no less diverse. New factions are being founded. More will surely follow. As a people, how well we navigate these differences will determine our fate.

descriptions.zh:
我们是一个拥有众多星球的民族，随着时间的推移，我们已经认识到多样性的宝贵价值。然而，要让几种不同的文化间保持平衡并非易事，更不要说完全不同的物种在生理上的需求也各不相同。我们之间隔阂渐生，尽管到现在为止，我们依然想方设法驾驭住了不断变化的政治格局，但我们不能对社会中固有的分歧视而不见了。

现在许多人呼吁成立一个特别委员会，来调和这些改革的呼声。
descriptions.en:
We are a people of many worlds, and over time we have learned the value of diversity. However, negotiating the dynamics of several different cultures - not to mention the physical needs of completely distinct species - has not been easy. Our differences run deep, and while we have managed to navigate the shifting political landscape up to now, the divisions inherent in our society have grown impossible to ignore.

Many are now calling for a special committee to be formed to moderate the calls for reform.

label.zh: 这是在无用地浪费资源。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 当多样化的思想聚集在一起时，难以预料他们能够实现什么样的成就；我们的研究团队增加了一名新晋的、非[Root.GetSpeciesName]成员，此人已经取得了一些新的研究成果。
descriptions.en: When diverse minds come together, there's no telling what they can accomplish; the addition of a new, non [Root.GetSpeciesName] member to our research team is already producing results.

descriptions.zh: 作为一个起源于众多不同星球的民族，整合全体人民绝非易事。然而，我们多元化的艺术传统经过融合，产生了令人难以置信的创造力的源泉，广受好评的新产品层出不穷。无数艺术家和设计师涌现出来，他们都受到多元化的启发，不断拓展表现手法的前沿。国内相关产业得到空前的蓬勃发展，我们的人民从未像现在这样投身于这些事业。
descriptions.en: As a people of many worlds, integration has not been without its challenges. However, the synthesis of our diverse artistic traditions has resulted in an incredible amount of creative energy. New products are being promoted. Countless artists and designers have emerged, all inspired to push the boundaries of expression. Domestic industry is thriving, and our people have never been more engaged.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
这一刻如期而至：我们与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!建立了联系。

在起义后，有的人希望我们苟全性命于乱世，但显然弥那玛特种实业集团早已发现我们在星系舞台上的存在了。只有对利益的考虑可以阻止他们回来[Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]拿回他们的“合法财产”。看来我们还不值得他们这么做。
descriptions.en:
The moment we have long anticipated has arrived: we have made contact with §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

After the mutiny, some hoped we could avoid detection, but it is now clear that Minamar Specialized Industries have been aware of our presence on the galactic stage for some time. Only the pursuit of profit has kept them from returning to [Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName] to collect their 'legal assets.' It seems we weren't worth the cost of travel.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的代表会见了我们的特使并表达的善意。但我们很明白这些允诺有多么地空洞虚伪。

公司来到我们的星球，允诺带来更好的生活。他们利用花言巧语和蝇头小利打通了我们领导层的关系，然后签订了协议并获得了贷款。资本开始运作，我们市场中的商品瞬间充盈了起来。在我们搞明白发生了什么之前一切都已经结束了：我们成了MSI的私有财产。

这种事情不会再发生了。随着我们走向星系舞台，独立自主变得非常重要。
descriptions.en:
Representatives from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! have approached our envoy with offers of friendship. But we know how hollow such assurances are.

The corporation first arrived on our worlds with promises of a better life. With sweet words and lavish gifts, they softened our leaders. Loans were provided; contracts signed. Investment capital flowed, and our marketplaces flooded with goods. Before we fully understood what was happening, it had already been done: we had become assets, and MSI our masters.

Never again. As we push forward on the galactic stage, it's essential that we stand on our own.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
经过了一系列冗长而措辞激烈的会议，我们与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!终于是正式建交了。然而，无论他们如何强调亲善，我们也绝不会忘记他们对我们的母星所犯下的罪行。想到这个公司还逍遥法外，肆意地像对待过去的我们一样奴役他人……我们早已出离愤怒。

过去他们把我们视为财产和工具。现在我们要让他们知道自由民的厉害。
descriptions.en:
After a prolonged and often intense series of meetings, diplomatic relations have been established between ourselves and §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!. However, no matter their claims of friendship, we have not forgotten what they did to our home worlds. The thought that this corporation has been left unpunished, free to enslave others as they once did us... The emotion goes beyond words.

Once they called us property. Let us teach them the value of a free people.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们派往星海共同体的代表汇报：已经与[MSI_country.GetName]建立联络。

公司来到我们的星球，允诺带来更好的生活。他们利用花言巧语和蝇头小利打通了我们领导层的关系，然后签订了协议并获得了贷款。在我们搞明白发生了什么之前一切都已经结束了：我们成了他们的私有财产。必须给星海共同体的成员提个醒，千万不要上MSI的当。
descriptions.en:
Word from our representatives at the Galactic Community: contact has been made with [MSI_country.GetName].

The corporation first arrived on our worlds with promises of a better life. With sweet words and lavish gifts, they softened our leaders. Loans were provided; contracts signed. Before we truly understood what was happening, it had already been done: we had become assets, and they our masters. The members of the Galactic Community must be warned. MSI cannot be trusted.

descriptions.zh: 我们在星海共同体的联系人向我们传递了消息：正在制定相关法律法规，意在禁止全星系范围内的奴隶劳工和奴隶牲口制度。如果我们真心想要支持自由，那么就必须旗帜鲜明地站在改革的一方。如果我们没能作出行动，我们的人民会怎么想？
descriptions.en: Word has reached us from our contacts at the Galactic Community: legislation is in the works that would ban chattel and livestock slavery throughout the galaxy. If we truly profess to favor freedom, we must stand on the side of change. What will our people think, if we fail to act?

options.script: name = UNDERSTOOD

titles.zh: 绝大多数的奴隶制度被取缔

descriptions.zh: 今天对于星海共同体来说是伟大的一天，各成员国投票决定将绝大多数形式的奴隶制裁定为非法。星系的人们再也不需要担心被下作的暴徒和唯利是图的公司压迫了。尽管在确保所有感性生命体的自由权利方面，我们还有很长的路要走，但此次裁定代表了重要的第一步。
descriptions.en: A great day at the Galactic Community, where members voted to outlaw most forms of slavery. No longer will the people of the galaxy need to fear oppression at the hands of petty thugs and profit-hungry corporations. Although there is a long way to go before the right of all sentient beings to freedom is ensured, this represents an important first step.

label.zh: 开明的思想取得了胜利。

descriptions.zh: 今天对于星海共同体来说是一个令人心碎的日子，取缔绝大多数形式的奴隶制的动议未能获得足够的票数。由于压迫性政权和剥削性公司以恶毒的手段进行了阻挠，在可预见的未来，这种可憎的做法将继续下去。
descriptions.en: A heartbreaking day at the Galactic Community, where a motion to outlaw most forms of slavery failed to gain enough votes. Due to the malign presence of oppressive regimes and exploitative corporations, this detestable practice will continue for the foreseeable future.

descriptions.zh: 我们在星海共同体的联系人向我们传递了消息：正在制定相关法律法规，意在禁止绝大多数形式的奴隶制，包括可憎的契约式奴役。如果我们自己的斗争经验能教会我们什么，那就是如果不发声诉求，权力是不会让步的。一个地方一旦存在奴隶制，就不可能有正义。我们必须与星系中其他开明的成员国站在一起。只有这样做，我们才能保证我们人民的安全和尊严。
descriptions.en: Word has reached us from our contacts at the Galactic Community: legislation is in the works that would ban most forms of slavery, including the abomination of indentured servitude. If our own experience has taught us anything, it is that power concedes nothing without a demand. Where slavery exists, there can be no justice. We must stand together with the other enlightened members of the galaxy. Only by doing so can we guarantee the safety and dignity of our people.

options.script: name = UNDERSTOOD

descriptions.zh: 今天对于星海共同体来说是值得载入史册的重要日子，各成员国投票决定禁止一切形式的奴隶制——甚至包括契约奴役这样的卑劣做法。像弥那玛特种实业集团这样的公司将不再能够以利润的名义剥削无辜者。终于，星系历史上最黑暗的篇章之一可以结束了。
descriptions.en: A monumental day at the Galactic Community, where members voted to ban all forms of slavery - including the vile practice of indentured servitude. No longer will corporations like Minamar Specialized Industries be able to exploit the innocent in the name of profit. At last, one of the darkest chapters in galactic history can finally come to a close.

descriptions.zh: 星海共同体传来令人心碎的消息，一场取缔一切形式的奴隶制的运动失败了。由于压迫性政权和剥削性公司以恶毒的手段进行了阻挠，在可预见的未来，这种可憎的做法将继续下去。
descriptions.en: Heartbreak at the Galactic Community, where a motion to outlaw all forms of slavery has failed. Due to the malign presence of oppressive regimes and exploitative corporations, this detestable practice will continue for the foreseeable future.

descriptions.zh: 我们在星海共同体的联系人向我们传递了消息：正在制定相关法律法规，意在禁止对有机体的奴役，而且是全方位的。对于我们来说，这件事没有妥协的余地。奴隶制是星系篇章上的污点。我们必须尽一切所能，彻底地将其终结。
descriptions.en: Word has reached us from our contacts at the Galactic Community: legislation is in the works that would ban the enslavement of all organic populations. For us, there can be no compromise. Slavery is a stain upon the galaxy. We must do what we can to end it permanently.

options.script: name = UNDERSTOOD

descriptions.zh: 今天是泛星系贸易市场的重要一日，我们决定将有机体奴役裁定为非法。人民再也不需要担心被下作的暴徒和唯利是图的公司压迫了。今晚我们都可以睡个好觉了。
descriptions.en: A monumental day at the Galactic Market, which made the decision today to outlaw the enslavement of organic populations. No longer will the people of the galaxy need to fear oppression at the hands of petty thugs and profit-hungry corporations. We can all rest easier tonight.

descriptions.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的行动受到了挫折，各成员国决定继续放任邪恶的奴隶制度下的各类行径。由于压迫性政权和剥削性公司以恶毒的手段进行了阻挠，在可预见的未来，这种可憎的做法将继续下去。
descriptions.en: Frustration at the Galactic Market, as members agreed to continue the vile practice of slavery. Due to the malign presence of oppressive regimes and exploitative corporations, this detestable practice will continue for the foreseeable future.

descriptions.zh: 我们在星海共同体的联系人向我们传递了消息：正在制定相关法律法规，意在禁止对智慧生命体的奴役，而且是全方位的。无论是哪个物种，一旦在有思想的个体身上套上锁链，最终一定会发现锁链的另一端套在了自己身上。我们必须支持这项动议。
descriptions.en: Word has reached us from our contacts at the Galactic Community: legislation is in the works that would ban the slavery of all forms of sentient life. No species can put a chain on a thinking individual without at last finding the other end fastened to themselves. We must support this motion.

options.script: name = UNDERSTOOD

titles.zh: 属于全体智慧生命的胜利
titles.en: A Victory for All Sentient Beings

descriptions.zh: 今天对于泛星系贸易市场来说是历史性的一天，各成员国投票通过废除奴隶制议案。自由成为了全体感性生命的天然权利。今日，星海历史中不光彩的一章体面地完结了。
descriptions.en: A historic day at the Galactic Market, where members voted to outlaw slavery in all its forms. Freedom is the natural right of all sentient beings. Today, a vile chapter in galactic history comes to a merciful close.

descriptions.zh: 今天是泛星系贸易市场上令人沮丧的一天，各国作出决策，决定继续出售感性的非有机体生命。再一次，权力和金钱驱使的恶行扼杀了自由的事业。只要还有一个有情感的生命体佩戴着镣铐——无论这生命是天然孕育还是人工制造——就没有人可以高枕无忧。
descriptions.en: A frustrating day at the Galactic Market, where the decision was made to continue the sale of sentient non-organics. Once again, the malign influence of power and money have stifled the cause of freedom. No one - whether organic or artificial - can rest easy while even a single sentient being is forced into bondage.

descriptions.zh: 企业的势力已经成功地废除了星海共同体最近制定的反对奴隶制的议案。虽然这一切令人失望，但此等不幸的发展并不出乎意料；历史是螺旋上升的，而且螺线有时候会很长，但最终，自由的事业终将取得胜利。
descriptions.en: Corporate forces have succeeded in repealing the Galactic Community's recent resolution against slavery. While this is disappointing, unfortunately it is not unexpected; the arc of history runs long, but in the end, the cause of freedom will prevail.

descriptions.zh:
我们在旧主的阴影下苟且偷生的日子太久了，我们享受着这应得的自由之时，有太多的同胞还在作为契约奴隶遭受着他们的羞辱。一些人可能会将这视作侵略战争并加以谴责。不管怎样，反抗暴政的时机已到。这些星系中的流氓和利润贩子将不再被准许继续他们那卑鄙的勾当。

今天，我们迈向战争。
descriptions.en:
For too long we have lived in fear of our former masters, but while we enjoy the benefit of a freedom justly earned, far too many continue to suffer under the indignities of indentured servitude. Some may decry this as a war of aggression. Nevertheless, the time has come for us to strike a blow against tyranny. No longer will the petty thugs and profit-mongers of the galaxy be allowed to ply their vile trade.

Today, we march to war.

descriptions.zh:
弥那玛特种实业集团的糖衣炮弹没有成功，于是现在他们要来硬的了。他们的董事会认为我们软弱可欺。但解开了枷锁的我们早已如钢铁般铸成一体了。

此战非我所愿，但我们将给它画上句号。
descriptions.en:
Having failed to conquer us with money and lies, Minamar Specialized Industries will now try with force. Their Board of Directors believe us weak. But in casting off our shackles, we have forged an identity that can never be broken.

We did not seek out this war. But we will end it.

descriptions.zh: 意想不到的事情发生了。[From.GetName]赢了，而我们再一次回到了他们的束缚之下。尽管我们输掉了这场战争，但争取自由与平等的斗争还远未结束。
descriptions.en: The unthinkable has happened. [From.GetName] is victorious, and once more we find ourselves bent beneath their yoke. But while we may have lost this war, the battle for equality and justice is far from over.

descriptions.zh: 我们同[MSI_country.GetName]达成了一个维持现状协议。但是它们要知道我们并没有忘记曾经在它们手上受到过怎样的对待。我们也不打算忘记。
descriptions.en: We have reached a status quo agreement with [MSI_country.GetName]. But let it be known that we have not forgotten our treatment at their hands. Nor have we forgiven.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们胜利了。战胜[From.GetName]不仅让我们赢回了尊严，更证明了我们才是自己命运的主人。

解开枷锁让我们找到共同目标，而今天我们才算是真正重获自由。
descriptions.en:
Victory is ours. In defeating [From.GetName], we have not only reclaimed our dignity, but proven ourselves the masters of our own fate.

In casting off our chains, we found common purpose. Today we are truly free.

descriptions.zh: 弥那玛特种实业集团把我们从自己的星球家园中掳走，囚禁我们，用不平等的契约奴役我们。甚至现在，他们还妄想着在商业的幌子下继续进行那卑鄙的贸易。现在是时候彻底将它们终结了。
descriptions.en: Minamar Specialized Industries stole us from our worlds, imprisoned and indentured us. Even now, they continue their vile trade under a guise of commerce. The time has come to end them once and for all.

descriptions.zh:
上回弥那玛特种实业集团没能征服我们，他们再次挑起了战争。他们的董事会不是傻了就是疯了。自由的人民是不可战胜的。

此战非我所愿，但我们将给它画上句号。
descriptions.en:
Having already failed to subdue us, Minamar Specialized Industries has once again declared war. Their Board of Directors is either incompetent, mad, or both. A free people can never be broken.

We did not seek out this war. But we will end it.

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们饱尝着通过正当手段赢得的自由之甜果，星系中还有太多人继续在奴隶制和契约奴役的屈辱下受苦。星系中的流氓和利润贩子别想继续从事他们卑鄙的交易。

现在是时候我们站出来反抗此等暴政了。
descriptions.en:
While we enjoy the benefit of a freedom justly earned, far too many in the galaxy continue to suffer under the indignities of slavery and indentured servitude. No longer will the petty thugs and profit-mongers of the galaxy be allowed to ply their vile trade.

The time has come for us to take a stand against such tyranny.

descriptions.zh:
今天，我们加入了一个有§Y弥那玛特种实业集团§!存在的联邦。

在我们重获自由之初绝不可能想到未来会有这样的展开。如今我们可以心平气和地与过去的压迫者们展开外交，这说明了我们的国家已经步入成熟。

显然，会有很多人不满意这一决定。但这次情况特殊，目的确实证明了手段的正确。
descriptions.en:
Today, we enter into a federation with §YMinamar Specialized Industries§!.

When we first claimed our freedom, such a development would have been unthinkable. That we are now able to engage in peaceful diplomacy with our erstwhile captors speaks to the growing maturity of our nation.

There are those among us who will not be happy with this decision. But in this case, the ends truly justify the means.

descriptions.zh: 今天，我们作出了一个艰难的决定，与一个已知的奴隶主国家结成联盟。虽然我们认为每个有情感的生命体的自由是不可剥夺的权利，但国家的需要迫使我们做出妥协。我们的人民可能不高兴，但我们这样做是为了更加长远的利益。
descriptions.en: Today, we have made the difficult decision to enter into a federation with a known slaver. While we consider the freedom of every sentient being an inalienable right, the necessities of state have forced us to compromise. Our people may not be happy, but we have done this for the greater good.

descriptions.zh: 各类大众媒体上满是关于所谓跨物种融合的失败报道。特别值得关注的是，由于某些变种从未进化到能在特定星球上定居，为了支援这一部分特别的人群所划拨的额外款项。随着紧张局势的持续升温，安全部队报告道，物种间冲突急剧上升，已到了警报级别。
descriptions.en: Popular media is awash with reports about the supposed failure of inter-species integration. Of particular concern is the cost of supporting certain populations on worlds their xenotype never evolved to inhabit. As tensions continue to rise, security forces have reported an alarming increase in inter-species conflict.

label.zh: 我们不会为言论自由设下限制。
label.en: We will not place limits on freedom of speech.

label.zh: 对媒体进行约谈，让他们不要阴阳怪气。
label.en: Instruct the media to tone down their rhetoric.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
特别委员会发布了一份关于我们社会中政治割裂的详尽研究。他们发现了在[Root.GetName]中，有三种主要的驱动力在促使政治发生多极化。

1、为满足各个不同种族的最低生活标准需要投入不均等的花费。

2、在各个截然不同的文化群体中存在互不相容的信仰体系和行为准则。

3、我们的政治体制与特定的物种价值观存在冲突甚至是完全相反。
descriptions.en:
The special committee has published the findings of an exhaustive study of the political divisions within our society. They have identified three main issues driving political polarization within [Root.GetName]:

1. The unequal costs associated with providing a minimum standard of living to diverse xenotypes.

2. The discordant belief systems and behaviors between several distinct culture groups.

3. The nature of our political authority as being in conflict with (or even antithetical to) the values of certain species.

tooltips.zh: §L确保我们社会中的每一个个体都有公平和平等的利益，这件事情既不简单，也不省事。但它是必要的。§!
tooltips.en: §LEnsuring a fair and equal stake for every individual in our society will not be simple, or cheap. But it is necessary.§!

tooltips.zh: §L在跨文化交往中进行投资，未来肯定能获得好处。§!
tooltips.en: §LInvesting in cross-cultural engagement is sure to pay dividends in the future.§!

tooltips.zh: §L一切皆为政治。一个健康的社会会主动投资、培养高参与、高活跃的公民群体。§!
tooltips.en: §LEverything is political. A healthy society is one that invests in an engaged and active citizenry.§!

label.zh: 这些议题是相互联系的。

tooltips.zh: §L纠正我们社会中的系统性问题将需要大量的时间和资源投入。§!
tooltips.en: §LRighting the systemic problems in our society will require a massive investment in time and resources.§!

label.en: It is cheaper to reign in the media.

tooltips.zh: §L政府对媒体进行监管，能够减少政治上的分裂和对立。§!
tooltips.en: §LGovernment oversight of the media is necessary to reduce political polarization.§!

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 政府的监管可能有助于淡化政治上的不和，但对消除社会中的分歧却起不到什么作用。社群领袖不断地在各物种和文化群体之间挑拨离间。根据信息网络上公布的材料，这个问题只会变得愈发糟糕。
descriptions.en: Governmental oversight may have helped to tone down the political discourse, but it has done little to combat the divisions in society. Community leaders continue to sow discord between various species and culture groups. Based on the kind of material being published on the information net, the problem is certain to get worse before it gets better.

label.zh: 我们需要从根源上解决这个问题。
label.en: We need to address the root causes of this issue.
Restrict access to the information net.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 几个月以来，我们限制了公众对信息网络的访问。虽然这能够阻止政治领域的一些偏激分子找到发声的平台，但物种间冲突的根本原因却没有得到遏制。暴力，包括对财产的大规模破坏，在我们的各个恒星系都呈上升趋势。
descriptions.en: For several months now, we have restricted public access to the information net. While this prevented some of the more outlandish voices in the political spectrum from finding a platform, the root causes of inter-species conflict have gone unchecked. Violence, including the mass destruction of property, is on the rise throughout our systems.

label.zh: 不惜一切代价恢复秩序。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们的安保部队已经成功地恢复了我们所有恒星系的社会秩序。各类政治激进分子要么被围捕，要么被监禁，他们的领袖现在面临叛国罪的指控。

回顾我们历史上这段令人遗憾的时期，有一点是非常清楚的：像我们这样的社会只能由强硬的手腕来管理。现在是时候由我们提供强硬的手腕了。
descriptions.en:
Our security forces have succeeded in restoring order throughout our systems. Political radicals of all stripes have been rounded up and imprisoned, and their leaders now face charges of treason against the state.

As we look back on this regrettable period in our history, one thing is abundantly clear: a society like ours can only be governed by a firm hand. It is high time we provided one.

label.zh: 只有团结一致，才能繁荣昌盛。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们的社会自建立之初，就充斥着冲突。也许事情在变好之前不可避免地会变得更糟；在整个信息网络上，仇恨团体激增。要求将一个或另一个物种从我们的星域中驱逐出去的呼声已经是随处可见了。然而，也有迹象表明，人们对共同斗争的意识也有所提高。

一些团体，除了对变革的渴望之外几乎没有什么共同点，但依然愈发频繁地走到了一起。通过直面我们的问题，在其他文明可能归于黑暗的事物，我们成功将其照亮。也许有一天，我们会把这段冲突的岁月看作是历史大势的转折点。
descriptions.en:
From its founding, our society has been shaped by conflict. Perhaps it was inevitable that things would get worse before they got better; across the information net, hate groups proliferate. Calls for the expulsion of one or another species from our systems are all too common. Yet there are also signs of increased awareness of a shared struggle.

Groups with little more in common than a desire for change have been coming together with increasing regularity. By confronting our issues head-on, we have shone a light on what otherwise might have grown in darkness. Perhaps one day we will look back on this time of conflict as the turning of the tide.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
这届政府为提高我们公民的生活质量做出了不懈努力。我们投资于教育、犯罪预防和各种文化项目。然而，我们却不断地注意到自己成为了无情抨击的对象。更过分的是，一个由年轻人组成的跨物种运动已经组织起来，呼吁进行更激进的改革，变革的步子要迈得更大。

这里只有一线希望：通过激励年轻人踊跃行动，我们可能在不知不觉中创造了弥合我们社会分裂的必要条件。
descriptions.en:
This government has worked tirelessly to improve the quality of life for our citizenry. We have invested in education, crime prevention, and cultural programs of all kinds. Nevertheless, we continue to find ourselves the target of relentless criticism. What's more, a cross-species movement of young people has organized, calling for more radical reforms and a faster pace of change.

There is only one silver lining to be found here: in galvanizing the youth to act, we may have unwittingly created the conditions necessary to heal the divisions in our society.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们一直在努力推动营造清朗良好的政治氛围，然而到目前为止，普通民众几乎没有表现出参与政治的意愿。民意调查一直表明，构成我们社会的各物种和文化之间仍然存在重大分歧。

明显相关的是，我们的经济学家已经注意到消费者支出的明显增加。虽然这在短期内可能对企业有利，但它也导致了通货膨胀的飙升。或许是我们的人民已经厌倦了争斗和不和谐。

讽刺的是，作为政治上的结果，这些人因为在烧钱上志同道合而团结了起来。
descriptions.en:
Despite ongoing efforts to promote a healthy political climate, thus far, the general population has shown little engagement. Public opinion polls have consistently demonstrated that significant divisions remain between the various species and cultures that comprise our society.

In an apparent correlation, our economists have noticed a marked increase in consumer spending. While this may be good for business in the short-term, it has also led to a spike in inflation. It may be that our people have simply grown weary of the strife and discord.

Ironically, in tuning out politically, they have been united in a shared desire to consume.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 作为一个民族，我们面临着几乎无法克服的困难。我们曾是一群各种各样的奴隶，因为争取自由的斗争被捆在了一起，我们的道路从来都不是一帆风顺的。但是，通过选择将我们的资源集中用于正义事业，我们成功地塑造了作为一个国家的身份。一般而言，一定程度的政治不和总是客观存在的，但是我们之间塑造的连结却绝不会断裂。
descriptions.en: As a people, we faced nearly insurmountable odds. A diverse group of former slaves, thrown together in a struggle for freedom, our path has never been easy. But in choosing to concentrate our resources towards the cause of justice, we have succeeded in forging an identity as a nation. Naturally, a certain amount of political discord remains, but the bonds we've forged together can never be broken.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 从一开始，我们就面临着几乎无法克服的困难。一群奴隶和契约仆人，联合起来为了摆脱自己的桎梏……还有什么样的基础能比这更强大更牢固呢？这并不容易，但通过选择促进跨文化的对话，我们已经创造了一个强健和繁荣的社会。一般而言，一定程度的政治不和总是客观存在的，但是我们之间塑造的连结却绝不会断裂。
descriptions.en: From the beginning, we faced nearly insurmountable odds. A group of slaves and indentured servants, banding together to cast off their shackles... What stronger foundation could there be? It has not been easy, but in choosing to foster cross-cultural dialogue, we have created a robust and thriving society. Naturally, a certain amount of political discord remains, but the bonds we've forged together can never be broken.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们中间很少有人想到，当我们揭竿而起诉求自由时，争取平等的斗争才刚刚开始。作为一个由来自多个星球的物种组成的民族，对我们来说，建立共识或找到共同点从来都不容易，但通过鼓励参与政治生活，我们成功地创造了一个健全和繁荣的社会。一般而言，一定程度的政治不和总是客观存在的，但是我们之间塑造的连结却绝不会断裂。
descriptions.en: Little did it occur to us that the struggle for equality had only just begun when we rose up to claim our freedom. As a people of many worlds, it has never been easy for us to build consensus or to find common ground, but by investing in political engagement, we have succeeded in creating a robust and flourishing society. Naturally, a certain amount of political discord remains, but the bonds we've forged together can never be broken.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
因为渴望自由而联合到一起，我们奋起反抗曾经的主人。但是，社会不仅仅由暴力组成。从政治分裂到经济上的不安全，我们面临着巨大的挑战，但现在，当我们开始看到为建立共识所付出的不懈努力终于开花结果时，我们有理由为自己的瞩目成就感到骄傲。

同一个国家，多样的民族；同一个民族，多元的文化。团结一致，我们无所不克。
descriptions.en:
United by a desire for freedom, we rose up against our former masters. But society is not made by violence alone. From political division to economic insecurity, we have faced massive challenges, but now, as we begin to see the results of a concerted effort to build consensus, we can rightly take pride in our accomplishments.

We are a nation of many people, and a people of many cultures. Together, there is no challenge we cannot overcome.

label.zh: 多元之中孕育着我们的力量。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们在穿越星辰的旅程中发现了各种奇迹。我们目睹了超越想象的景色，完成了乍一想根本不可能完成的壮举。作为一个民族，我们已经走了很远。但是，没有什么旅程，也没有什么奖励，比找到回家的路更重要。
descriptions.en: Our journey across the stars has revealed wonders. We have witnessed sights beyond imagination, accomplished feats that at first seemed impossible. As a people, we have traveled far. But no journey, and no reward, is greater than finding the way home.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们决定与弥那玛特种实业集团构成联邦时，质疑声四起。许多人认为与曾经压迫我们的人和解绝不会带来任何好处。在过去这种担忧不无道理。

如今，我们与MSI的理事会签订了第一项外交协议，我们应当消除一律。我们要放下成见，平等地一起向前看。
descriptions.en:
When we agreed to form a Federation with Minamar Specialized Industries, there was widespread skepticism. Many among us said no good could ever come from reconciling with our former masters. At the time, such concerns might have been warranted.

Today, as we sign our first diplomatic agreement with the MSI Board of Directors, all doubts should be dispelled. Together, we look to a shared future. Not as adversaries, but as equals.

descriptions.zh:
我们中的许多人曾以为这一天永远不会到来。今天，我们与弥那玛特种实业集团的董事会签订了正式的外交协议。

毫无疑问肯定有些人会反对这一决定。过去的伤痛绝不能被抹消，但也不能让我们在未来面前故步自封。

今天我们踏出了和解的第一步。
descriptions.en:
Many among us thought this moment would never come. Today, we have formally entered in a diplomatic agreement with the Board of Minamar Specialized Industries.

No doubt there are some who will oppose this decision. The past can never be erased. But neither should it define the course of the future.

Today we take the first steps towards reconciliation.

descriptions.zh: 在我们发动兵变之后，运奴船的工程舱被迅速重新布置成为一个基础的综合实验室。在适应了[Root.Capital.GetName]上的生活后，我们的工程师对其进行了改进和升级，以更好地满足他们的需求。
descriptions.en: After the mutiny, the engineering bay of the slaver vessel was rapidly repurposed to serve as a rudimentary lab complex. Having adapted to life on [Root.Capital.GetName] our engineers have made improvements and upgrades to better suit their needs.

tooltips.en: The §H£building£ Laboratory Complex§! on §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§! will be upgraded to §H£building£ Research Labs§!.

descriptions.zh: 在进行最初的几次行动的时候，我们新生的政府就匆忙地将运奴船的几层甲板进行了重新改造，成为一个基本的行政管理中心。现在我们已经在[Root.Capital.GetName]上站稳了脚跟，而这些设施也已经得到了升级。
descriptions.en: In one of their first acts, our fledgling government hastily repurposed several decks of the slaver vessel to serve as a rudimentary administrative hub. Now that we have firmly established ourselves on [Root.Capital.GetName], these facilities have been upgraded.

tooltips.zh: §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!上的§H£building£行政中心§!将升级为§H£building£行政办公楼§!。

在§Y[Root.GetName]§!的一片大陆上，我们的殖民船徐徐降落在一座巨大河口三角洲。这片气候温和的林地将会提供庇护所和唾手可得的原材料。

舰船已经被改造成了§Y舰船改装庇护所§!，作为指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数殖民者陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down at the mouth of a large river delta on one of the continents on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. This temperate, forested area will provide shelter and easy access to raw materials.

The ship has been converted into a §YReassembled Ship Shelter§! to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
我们的殖民船徐徐降落在了§Y[Root.GetName]§!上一个白雪皑皑的山谷中。周围的山脉带来了充足的保护，并且提供了可靠的水资源。

舰船已经被改造成了§Y舰船改装庇护所§!，作为指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数殖民者陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down in a snow-covered valley on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. The surrounding mountain chains offer sufficient protection from the elements and provide an reliable water supply.

The ship has been converted into a §YReassembled Ship Shelter§! to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
我们的殖民船缓慢的降落在覆盖着§Y[Root.GetName]§!广阔的草原上。这里的大气略微干燥但同样怡人，在确定着陆点的过程中也观察到一大群温顺的食草动物。

舰船已被改造成新居住地的行政基地，它的反应堆核心正在被拆除来用作殖民地的暂时能量来源。

数百个小帐篷和简易房环绕着星舰巨大的船体，殖民者开始大片大片地登陆——在这外星世界上的第一座[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]之城。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down on the sprawling savanna that covers most of §Y[Root.GetName]§!. The shimmering air is dry yet pleasant, and a large herd of docile herbivores can be seen observing from a distance as our first landing site is established.

The ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement, and its reactor core is in the process of being removed so that it may serve as the colony's temporary power source.

Hundreds of small tents and prefab shelters have sprung up around the former starship's massive hull as colonists begin to disembark in large numbers - the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
我们的舰船想方设法，以惊人且优雅的姿态在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上无数锯齿状的山峰中回旋，并成功降落在一个遮蔽山谷中的理想着陆点。

descriptions.en:
Our colony ship managed, with surprising grace, to maneuver between the massive peaks that are so prevalent in the jagged landscape of §Y[Root.GetName]§!. It touched down in a sheltered valley that will serve as an ideal first landing site.

The ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement, and its reactor core is in the process of being removed so that it may serve as the colony's temporary power source.

Hundreds of small tents and prefab shelters have sprung up around the former starship's massive hull as colonists begin to disembark in large numbers - the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
有一座环绕[From.GetName]的观测站，我们将更好地照看我们曾经的母星。这座观测站不仅会促进物质和文化交流，还能帮助我们改善这颗星球上人民的生活。

现在我们必须做出决定：在知道结果的前提下，我们是否愿意帮助我们的同胞走向群星？

毫无疑问，他们配得上在宇宙的舞台上加入我们，但他们真的准备好迈出这一步了吗？正如我们曾经经历过的，急速的社会变革的后果很可能是极端的。
descriptions.en:
With an observation post built around [From.GetName], we will be able to keep a much better watch on our former home world. Not only will this station facilitate material and cultural exchange, but it could also help us to improve the life of the people on the planet.

A decision must be made: are we willing to help our kin reach the stars, knowing what the results could be?

No doubt they deserve to join us on the galactic stage, but are they truly ready to make the leap? As we have seen firsthand, the consequences of rapid social change can be extreme.

descriptions.zh:
我们的观测站现在正处于环绕[From.GetName]的轨道上。从这个制高点俯瞰下去，我们可以为同胞们的点点成功感到喜悦，如果有必要的话，还能帮助他们应对挑战。

随着我们的发展，一个新的问题摆在了我们面前：我们是该让他们宁静地繁衍生息，还是让他们走向宇宙？两个选择都会有各自的风险，以及一定的回报。
descriptions.en:
Our observation post is now in orbit around [From.GetName]. From this vantage point, we can celebrate the successes of our kin, and if necessary, help them to mitigate their challenges.

As we move forward, a new question presents itself: should we leave them in peace, or help them reach the stars? Both choices carry their own risks, and their own rewards.

options.script: name = UNDERSTOOD

descriptions.zh:
我们提升[From.Capital.GetName]使其登上星海舞台的工作取得了巨大的成功。在一个新近统一的政府的领导下，我们的亲族将被称为“[From.GetName]”。

在接下来的几个月和几年里，他们肯定要经历很多挑战。为了帮助它们在一个飘渺不定的星系中正确地前行，我们同意接纳他们作为附庸，至少目前是如此。与之相应地，我们已经交出了对该恒星系的完全控制权，并拆除了我们的观测站。
descriptions.en:
Our work to uplift [From.Capital.GetName] to the galactic stage has been a resounding success. Under a newly unified government, our kin will be known as the "[From.GetName]."

In the months and years ahead, they are sure to experience many challenges. In order to help them navigate an uncertain galaxy, we have agreed to accept them as vassals, at least for the time being. Accordingly, we have ceded full control of the system and dismantled our Observation Post.
